people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
translations.bsb: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
translations.kjv: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
translations.asv: but insomuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exceeding joy.
